input: What did Snowflake say about consumption trends on its most recent earnings call?

output.question: What did Snowflake say about consumption trends on its most recent earnings call?

passages.quote: Q2 benefited from continued strength in our core data platform business and a meaningful step-up in AI revenue.
Customers using AI on Snowflake consume more across the data platform, creating a structural multiplier for our business.

We track this metric called like time to 80% of purchased consumption for new logos that we acquire and we measure it cohort by cohort. … And this metric has very, very visibly improved for the newest cohorts of customers that we are acquiring.
At this time, we aren't ready to share the exact uplift numbers
The conference call will begin at 2 p.m. Pacific Time on December 2, 2026.

output.answer: As of November 10, 2026, Snowflake’s most recent earnings call was its September 2 Q2 FY2027 call, where management reported continued strength in its core data platform and a meaningful step-up in AI revenue. It said customers using AI consume more across the broader data platform, making AI a “structural multiplier” for the business. Management also said its measure of how quickly new customers reach 80% of purchased consumption had “very, very visibly improved” for the newest customer cohorts. However, it declined to disclose the exact consumption uplift associated with AI adoption.
caveats: Management described the AI-related consumption uplift qualitatively; it did not disclose an exact uplift figure.
These observations were made on September 2, 2026, rather than measuring consumption as of November 10; the next earnings call is scheduled for December 2, 2026.

key_facts.fact: On its Q2 FY2027 earnings call, Snowflake reported continued core-platform strength and a meaningful step-up in AI revenue.
Management said customers using AI consume more across Snowflake’s broader data platform.
The cohort-based metric tracking new customers’ progress toward 80% of purchased consumption had visibly improved for the newest cohorts.
Management declined to disclose exact consumption-uplift numbers for AI adoption.
Snowflake scheduled its Q3 FY2027 results and earnings call for December 2, 2026, after the answer’s November 10 cutoff.
